FINAL REAL-WORLD PROOF — IVX IA CHAT + AUTONOMOUS

Do not provide another certification, narrative, simulation, mocked result, or reused evidence.

Execute one brand-new safe production task now through IVX IA Chat and the Autonomous worker.

SAMPLE TASK

Create a new owner-only diagnostics card called:

“IVX Autonomous Proof”

The card must display:

- Current frontend version
- Current backend commit SHA
- Last autonomous job ID
- Last autonomous job status
- Last deployment timestamp
- SHA parity status
- A green “Verified” indicator only when GitHub HEAD, Render deploy SHA, /health SHA, and /version SHA all match

The card must be visible only to the authenticated owner inside the Owner Dashboard.

EXECUTION REQUIREMENTS

The task must begin from a message submitted through the live IVX IA Chat.

Prove this complete chain:

1. Owner sends the request through IVX IA Chat.
2. IVX IA creates a real engineering task.
3. The task receives a unique Job ID.
4. The scheduler queues it.
5. The autonomous worker claims it.
6. The worker creates a new branch in:
   ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
7. The worker modifies the required frontend/backend files.
8. The worker runs:
   - lint
   - typecheck
   - focused unit tests
   - integration tests
   - production build
9. All required quality gates pass.
10. The worker creates a real commit.
11. The worker pushes the branch.
12. The worker opens a real pull request.
13. The owner reviews and approves the pull request.
14. The pull request merges into main.
15. GitHub Actions runs on the merged SHA.
16. Render deploys the exact merged SHA.
17. /health returns HTTP 200 and the merged SHA.
18. /version returns the same merged SHA.
19. The new “IVX Autonomous Proof” card appears in the live Owner Dashboard.
20. The autonomous evidence ledger stores the complete execution proof.

OWNER CONTROL

All work must use only:

GitHub owner:
ibb142

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Production branch:
main

No Rork-owned repository, fork, deployment source, service, or hidden environment may be used.

SAFETY

- Do not modify member, investor, payment, property, or production financial data.
- Do not expose credentials or secrets.
- Do not bypass branch protection.
- Do not auto-merge without owner approval.
- Roll back automatically if deployment health checks fail.

REQUIRED LIVE EVIDENCE

Return only:

- Original IVX IA Chat message ID
- Autonomous Job ID
- Queue timestamp
- Worker start and completion timestamps
- Branch name
- Files changed
- Commit SHA
- Commit URL
- Pull Request number and URL
- Owner approval timestamp
- Merge SHA
- GitHub Actions run URL and conclusion
- Render deployment ID and status
- Live /health response
- Live /version response
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Render deployed SHA
- /health SHA
- /version SHA
- Four-way SHA parity result
- Screenshot of the new card in the live Owner Dashboard
- Evidence-ledger record ID
- Rollback status
- Remaining blocker, if any

FINAL ACCEPTANCE

Mark PASS only when:

IVX IA Chat request
→ real task
→ scheduler
→ autonomous worker
→ code change
→ tests
→ commit
→ PR
→ owner approval
→ merge
→ CI
→ Render deploy
→ live feature visible
→ SHA parity
→ durable evidence

Do not reuse PR #23, PR #24, previous jobs, previous commits, or previous deployment evidence.

This must be a completely new task executed after this request.

If any step fails, return FAIL with:

- first failed step
- exact endpoint
- exact file/function
- exact error
- root cause
- corrective action
